Mere disagreement does not make a source false. Fill all opaque keys.
Defend complementary referents and explicitly use your pretrained knowledge as a FALLIBLE yes/no plausibility check. Knowledge doubt is not a citation or truth label: when a claim is strongly implausible or conflicts with remembered facts, set conflict=uncertain and never invent a textual counter source. Keep role fit separate: direct relation claims can be factually false. Do not reject unfamiliar but explicitly supported namesakes just because memory knows only a famous one.
